summary: Kevin Hern stated in October 2024 that Israel has his 'full support' to 'destroy Hamas' and in February 2025 declared 'no defense for the behavior of the Palestinian people' and 'only one side in this war with a righteous cause.' He also voted Yea on H.R. 6090, directing use of the IHRA definition in Title VI education-discrimination enforcement. His words and recorded vote mark him as an unqualified defender of Israel's military campaign in Gaza.
